lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are distributed along the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region, forming a structured, grid-like spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular clusters, forming a lattice where the blobs serve as primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The surface area of the first dorsal fin contains approximately twelve high-luminance circular clusters, distributed unevenly with higher density in the posterior region of the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a unique distribution of high-luminance circular clusters concentrated primarily along the leading edges of both the upper and lower lobes.
